newsitem.title: FINLAND: IVO adviser sees few synergies with Neste - paper.
newsitem.headline: IVO adviser sees few synergies with Neste - paper.

text.p: Finnish state-run power producer Imatran Voima's (IVO) adviser Salomon Brothers sees few synergies in a merger of IVO and state-controlled oil and energy group Neste, business daily Kaupalehti reported on Tuesday.
The government and Neste on June 17 announced plans to study broadening ownership in Neste and IVO, and options for joint development of the two, including a possible merger.
"IVO and Neste do not really have any business operations the merger of which would create synergy benefits and thus improved profitability," the paper quoted Salomon Brothers as saying.
It said IVO's management declined to give an official comment on the cooperation plan.
Neste executives have said a merger with IVO would be good for its shareholders, consumers and the Finnish state.
